items.title: multimodal-art-projection/YuE
items.summary: YuE2 是由 multimodal-art-projection 发布的音乐生成模型，在 WildSongBench 评测中以 best-of-8 设置取得 6.9632 的 SongBench 平均分，与 Suno v5/v6 持平。该模型采用 AR–NAR Mixture-of-Transformers 骨干网络，通过显式符号规划（旋律与和弦）实现可编辑创作、零样本翻唱及多轮 Agent 交互式编辑，支持 `plan() → generate_semantic() → synthesize() → decode()` 流水线。推理需配备支持 BF16 且显存 ≥24GB 的 NVIDIA GPU，可直接生成 48kHz 立体声音频。

items.title: I connected an authentic fruit fly brain to Polymarket order books via WebGL
items.summary: 作者将真实果蝇大脑的神经元形态（MaleCNS v1.0 SWC骨架）接入Polymarket CLOB WebSocket实时行情，创建开源项目**Degeneret Fly**，以传统算法机器人所用的线性启发式或基础LLM之外的实验性方案进行决策。项目基于**8.333 ms Leaky Integrate-and-Fire（LIF）积分循环**，将深度不平衡与买卖价差速度直接注入突触电流，并通过果蝇神经调质Octopamine动态调整动作电位阈值，结合**Three.js/WebGL2**实现实时3D角色动画与交易执行，代码以MIT协议开源。
items.summary_en: Degeneret Fly is an open-source MIT-licensed pipeline that drives a WebGL character using authentic MaleCNS v1.0 fruit fly neuron morphology to interface with Polymarket's order book. Market telemetry (depth imbalance, spread velocity) injects as synaptic current into sensory neurons within an 8.333 ms Leaky Integrate-and-Fire loop, where octopamine dynamically scales thresholds and descending neurons gate execution.

items.title: LLM Inference Optimization: Techniques for Faster and Cheaper AI
items.summary: 文章介绍了五种LLM推理优化技术：量化（INT8/INT4可实现4-8倍加速，成本降低75%）、KV Cache优化（PagedAttention等方案可提速2倍，节省50%成本且无损质量）、投机解码（2.5倍加速，节省60%成本）以及Prompt优化（1.5倍加速，33%成本节约）。实际部署建议优先从KV Cache入手，边缘场景叠加量化，吞吐优化则采用投机解码。
items.summary_en: Key LLM inference optimization techniques include **quantization** (INT8 delivers 4x speedup with 75% cost reduction; INT4 offers 8x speedup), **KV Cache optimization** (2x speedup with 50% cost savings), and **speculative decoding** (2-3x speedup using a smaller draft model verified by a larger model). Prompt optimization and batch processing further reduce token usage and improve throughput. Start with KV Cache for the easiest gains, then layer in quantization for edge deployment or speculative decoding for higher throughput.

items.title: 2000+真实场景搬进仿真！一个导航模型零样本“通吃”四种机器人本体
items.summary: 亮源新创发布三项Physical AI技术：LightParkour通过物理仿真与课程学习将跑酷技能从单一障碍（45厘米）扩展至75厘米，实现多技能统一策略；LightNav-0基于Real2Sim2Real数据引擎，将2,000+个真实场景转化为仿真环境，生成4,000+小时训练数据，证明扩大环境覆盖度比增加相同环境轨迹数更能提升泛化能力；Light REACT面向外力扰动与硬件损伤场景提供全身韧性控制。三项技术共同构建从预训练、对齐到部署的规模化学习闭环。
items.summary_en: Liangyuan Xinchuang released three Physical AI technologies—LightParkour, LightNav-0, and Light REACT—advancing humanoid robot capability scaling from single tasks to unified, deployable systems. LightNav-0 converts 2,000+ real-world scenes into reusable simulations, generating 4,000+ hours of visual-language-action training data for general navigation. LightParkour grows complex contact skills from short human motion seeds via physics simulation and curriculum learning, covering obstacles up to 75cm on the Lightbot 0, while Light REACT enables resilient full-body control under external disturbances and hardware damage.

items.title: Show HN: ClientCoded – QA Platform for AI Agents
items.summary: ClientCoded 是一款专为 AI Agent 设计的 QA 测试平台，可生成覆盖 Salesforce、Jira、Stripe 等 35 个平台的合成测试环境，每个环境包含约 200 条对抗性查询及通过 SQL 计算的确定真值（而非 LLM 猜测），覆盖歧义问题、多步操作、矛盾输入等 7 类场景。该平台还支持对预生产对话 Agent 进行多角色对抗测试，并在 10 个维度上进行 pass/fail 评分；生产环境只需接入一个 webhook 即可实时评估每一轮对话。
items.summary_en: ClientCoded is a QA platform for AI agents that generates synthetic test environments for 35 platforms (including Salesforce, Jira, Stripe, Zendesk, and Datadog), each with ~200 adversarial queries across 7 categories like multi-step operations and contradictory inputs. Ground truth is computed via SQL rather than guessed by an LLM, and pre-production agents are tested with adversarial personas scored pass/fail across 10 dimensions. Production monitoring runs via a single webhook evaluating conversations in real time.

items.title: GitHub三榜第一背后，一个“专升本”工程师的十年
items.summary: Archify是一款可将模糊想法转化为清晰流程图和可视化图表的AI Agent工具，单日最高新增5000 Star，累计收获5.88万Star与3.8k Fork，项目与开发者均登顶GitHub热榜榜首。其创始人涂少坤出身河南农村，16岁辍学打工，后通过专升本进入重庆邮电大学软件工程专业，现为小红书AI Native工程师。该工具支持自然语言对话生成图表、手绘草图转流程图、以及将HTML嵌入飞书钉钉文档等场景。
items.summary_en: Archify, a GitHub OpenAPI-powered AI drawing agent developed by 26-year-old Tu Shaokun (a former vocational school dropout now working as an AI Native engineer at Xiaohongshu), has topped three GitHub leaderboards simultaneously, peaking at 5,000 new stars in a single day with 58.8K total stars and 3.8K forks. The tool converts vague ideas, workflows, or even hand-drawn sketches into clear, editable diagrams through natural-language AI interaction, and users have repurposed it for inserting into Feishu and DingTalk documents. Tu attributes the project's success to clearly showcasing its value upfront via the README and the growing demand among independent developers for creative, executable, and aesthetically polished tools.

directions.name: 本地AI助手一键部署工具
directions.description: 帮助用户在本地电脑上快速部署和运行大语言模型，提供开箱即用的桌面客户端和OpenAI兼容接口，无需复杂配置。
directions.description_en: A tool that enables users to quickly deploy and run large language models on their local computer with a ready-to-use desktop client and OpenAI-compatible API, requiring no complex configuration.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和一人公司创业者，希望自建AI服务但缺乏技术背景的群体
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and solopreneurs who want to build their own AI services but lack technical background.
core_features: 一键安装本地LLM运行环境（支持主流模型如Qwen、Llama）
自动生成OpenAI兼容API接口，方便对接现有应用
性能优化与监控面板，实时显示推理速度和资源使用情况
core_features_en: One-click installation of local LLM runtime (supports popular models like Qwen, Llama)
Automatically generates OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for easy integration
Performance optimization and monitoring dashboard showing real-time inference speed and resource usage
directions.why_now: 社区热议显示，用户已从MacBook迁移至RTX 3090 Linux机器，以100t/s的推理速度运行Qwen 3.8 27B模型，认为足以替代Claude订阅（Reddit r/LocalLLaMA评分7/10）。这反映了对低成本、高性能本地AI解决方案的迫切需求。开源工具热度上升（跨源热点3个源报道），为快速部署工具提供了技术基础。
directions.why_now_en: Community discussions show users migrating from MacBook to RTX 3090 Linux machines, achieving 100t/s inference speed with Qwen 3.8 27B, deeming it sufficient to replace Claude subscriptions (Reddit r/LocalLLaMA score 7/10). This reflects an urgent need for low-cost, high-performance local AI solutions. Rising popularity of open-source tools (cross-source hotspot: 3 source reports) provides a technical foundation for quick deployment.
directions.monetization: 一次性购买许可证（$49-99）或年度订阅（$99/年），提供高级功能和优先支持。
directions.monetization_en: One-time license purchase ($49-99) or annual subscription ($99/year), offering advanced features and priority support.

directions.name: AI驱动commit消息优化器
directions.description: 一个集成到开发者工作流的工具，自动扫描git历史，使用AI分析和重写commit消息，确保提交记录清晰、规范、符合团队标准。
directions.description_en: A tool integrated into developers' workflows that automatically scans git history, uses AI to analyze and rewrite commit messages, ensuring clear, standardized, and team-compliant commit records.
directions.target_user: 软件开发者和小型团队，需要维护高质量git提交历史的个人开发者
directions.target_user_en: Software developers and small teams needing to maintain high-quality git commit histories, individual developers.
core_features: 自动检测commit消息中的不规范用语（如内部issue ID、编码代理残留）
AI重写commit消息，生成符合语义化提交规范的描述
安全备份分支，允许预览和回滚修改
core_features_en: Automatically detects non-standard terminology in commit messages (e.g., internal issue IDs, encoding proxy residues)
AI rewrites commit messages to generate descriptions compliant with semantic commit standards
Safely creates backup branches for preview and rollback of changes
directions.why_now: 社区对commit-rewriter等开源工具表现出兴趣（Simon Willison博客RSS入选评分6/10），反映出开发者对清理commit历史、提升代码协作效率的需求。AI辅助编程热度持续上升，提供自动化重写commit消息的技术可行性。
directions.why_now_en: Community interest in open-source tools like commit-rewriter (Simon Willison blog RSS score 6/10) reflects a need for cleaning commit history and improving code collaboration efficiency. Rising popularity of AI-assisted programming makes automated commit message rewriting technically viable.
directions.monetization: 免费增值模式：基础功能免费，高级功能（如团队批量处理、自定义规则）订阅制（$9/月/用户）。
directions.monetization_en: Freemium model: basic features free, advanced features (e.g., team batch processing, custom rules) via subscription ($9/month/user).
